text: At the start of the review, the author reviews the draft with care. For consistency, the editor checks the summary against the original notes. Where clarification is needed, the reviewer lists the open questions for another discussion. Before changing the text, the editor reviews the alternative wording before making revisions. For a clearer structure, the reviewer examines the order of the main sections. To preserve useful context, the reviewer checks the supporting notes for additional context. Before the next revision, the reviewer lists the remaining corrections for the next version. As the review concludes, the editor assesses the corrected account before the next discussion.
